backward_compat_traps.rule: 8b10b is used at <=6 Gbps; 128b150b (FEC capable) is used at 12 and 22.5 Gbps.
backward_compat_traps.trap: Assuming 8b10b at 12/22.5 Gbps is wrong; the coding and FEC differ.

backward_compat_traps.rule: SAS multiplexes SSP (SCSI), STP (SATA tunneling), and SMP (management) over the phy.
backward_compat_traps.trap: Treating SAS as SSP-only ignores STP (SATA devices) and SMP (topology).

backward_compat_traps.rule: A connection (OPEN address frame, OPEN_ACCEPT) must be open before frames flow.
backward_compat_traps.trap: Sending frames without an open connection is invalid.

backward_compat_traps.rule: SAS has SSP/STP/SMP, expanders, a 64-bit SAS address, and wide ports; SATA is a single host-device FIS/AHCI link and NVMe is queues/doorbells over PCIe.
backward_compat_traps.trap: Applying SATA AHCI host-device assumptions or NVMe queue/doorbell semantics to SAS is wrong.

fields.spec_version: INCITS T10 Serial Attached SCSI — SAS-3 (12 Gbps) and SAS-4 (22.5 Gbps)

spec_lineage_ahci.summary: VS=0x00010200. Enclosure Management + Port Multiplier FIS-Based Switching.
VS=0x00010300. BIOS/OS Handoff + Asynchronous Notification + NVMHCI hooks + Automatic Partial→Slumber.

spec_lineage_sata_companion.summary: Gen 2 (3 Gbps), NCQ, Port Multiplier, Hot Plug.

key_changes.summary: Doubled the link rate to 6 Gbps; added zoning and self-configuring expanders; spread-spectrum clocking refinements. 8b10b coding retained.
Doubled the link rate to 12 Gbps; introduced 128b150b encoding with a forward error correction capability for the higher rate; transmitter training.
Doubled the link rate to 22.5 Gbps with 128b150b encoding and forward error correction. SSP/STP/SMP transports, 64-bit SAS address, wide ports, and expanders are carried forward.

fields.version_naming_history_note: Serial Attached SCSI is standardized by the INCITS T10 technical committee as a series of standards: SAS-1 (1.5/3 Gbps), SAS-2 (6 Gbps), SAS-3 (12 Gbps), and SAS-4 (22.5 Gbps). Each generation roughly doubles the link rate while preserving the SSP/STP/SMP transport architecture, the 64-bit SAS address, wide ports, and expander-based topology. SAS-3 introduced 128b150b FEC-capable encoding for the higher rates.
previous_versions: SAS-1 (2003-2005) — 1.5/3 Gbps; initial Serial Attached SCSI.

future_versions_industry_outline.summary: Continued INCITS T10 work on higher link rates and refined PHY/FEC; the SSP/STP/SMP architecture and expander/wide-port model are preserved.
